source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: No other XLSX row uses Wistron-HW-00294-V002.

source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if BP can detect NVMe sucessfully

1. Insert NVMe switch adapter and power on.
2. Boot into BIOS and check NVMe SSD in NVMe switch adapter information correctly.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Can enter into BIOS without any problems.
2. The controller info displays correctly.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Truncated smartctl and lsblk across NVMe or sd device names.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; conflates NVMe/SCSI device enumeration, cannot prove BIOS and does not address the authoritative transport conflict.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; identifies SAS/SATA versus NVMe conflict and requires owner scope resolution before physical/BIOS work.

original_test_intent: The source may intend either an all-SAS/SATA information check or an NVMe switch-adapter BIOS detection check. These require different hardware, topology, utilities and expected fields, so the accepted transport is unresolved.
original_method: Preserve both candidate workflows: SAS/SATA would use HBA/RAID/enclosure/SAS-address inventory for approved drives; NVMe would require switch-adapter installation, BIOS NVMe evidence and PCIe/NVMe correlation. Do not merge or silently select them.
manual_activity: The explicit procedure requires adapter installation, power-on and BIOS observation, but even those actions cannot be planned safely until the owner resolves whether the case is NVMe or SAS/SATA.
required_inputs: Case-specific decision: SAS/SATA information or NVMe switch/SSD information
Corresponding adapter/HBA/controller and complete drive serial/slot population
Power-state/ESD installation method, KVM and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not install or power hardware while transport and target are unresolved.
Do not infer SAS/SATA from `/dev/sd*` or NVMe from `/dev/nvme*` alone.
Do not initialize, format, mount or write any discovered drive.
OS inventory cannot replace the required BIOS display evidence.
No automatic reseat, BIOS change, reboot or alternate-transport attempt.
agent_execution_scope: Maintain separate NVMe and SAS/SATA evidence plans and record the conflict.
After owner resolution, validate exact hardware/topology and collect transport-specific inventory.
Correlate physical, BIOS, controller/BMC and OS identities only for the selected scope.
Report Tool Result without physical/BIOS claim or verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve and document the authoritative transport/test scope.
Approve/perform hardware installation and BIOS visual verification for that scope.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable until scope resolution; it mixes device classes, truncates evidence and cannot prove the physical or BIOS steps for either interpretation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use no command as an acceptance path until the owner selects transport; then use full HBA/SAS enclosure evidence or PCIe/NVMe evidence as appropriate.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SAS/SATA test-set/item wording, NVMe procedure, BIOS criteria and 15/8-minute fields are retained as conflicting facts.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After resolution, create a transport-specific serial/slot/firmware manifest and correlate operator BIOS media with complete controller and OS inventory.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Selected SAS/SATA or NVMe topology only.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, adapter/HBA/controller firmware, OS driver and utility versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Selected platform population and BIOS/controller documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Separates incompatible transport workflows rather than hiding the inconsistency.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Choosing incorrectly could install the wrong adapter and produce irrelevant evidence.

project_override_considerations: A project may explicitly select one transport and document it as an override without modifying master source; results cannot claim the unselected transport.
expected_evidence: Owner scope decision and selected population/specification
Safe installation/power approval and operator BIOS evidence
BMC/SEL/host health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Test Set and item identify SAS/SATA, while procedure and opening statement explicitly require an NVMe switch adapter, NVMe SSDs and NVMe backplane detection. DeepSeek then labels its mixed inventory as SAS/SATA evidence. These are different transports.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The hardware and operation cannot be selected safely or faithfully until an owner resolves the transport. This is a genuine intent/operation ambiguity, not a missing ordinary parameter.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects YES and mixed inventory as incapable of resolving or satisfying the source.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Adopts its conflict analysis and tightens classification to BLOCKED until the core transport is decided.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves both candidate intents and prevents a software inventory shortcut from rewriting the source.

review_improvement: Stops the wrong adapter/drive family from being tested and makes the necessary engineering decision explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: SAS/SATA and NVMe use different buses, controllers, addressing and firmware views. No safe common command or topology assumption can reconcile the source conflict, so BLOCKED is warranted.
no_automatic_retry: No hardware action, reboot or alternate-transport trial is permitted before owner resolution.
